description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different model layers for various KV cache compression methods, with the y-axis representing "Relative Change" in percentage, ranging from -15% to 5% on a linear scale, and the x-axis representing model layers, labeled as "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29" with no numerical scale or unit specified. Four distinct lines are plotted: a yellow line with circle markers representing "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit", which starts near 0%, rises to approximately 5% at Layer21-28, and ends near 7% at Layer29; a red line with square markers for "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,8-bit", which begins near 0%, slightly dips to about 2%, then rises to approximately 6% at Layer29; a cyan line with circle markers for "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit", which starts near 0%, rises to about 5% at Layer21-28, then dips to approximately -2% at Layer29; and a dark blue line with square markers for "RULER4k of 4×tokens,4-bit", which starts near -5%, rises to about 2% at Layer21-28, then dips sharply to approximately -15% at Layer13-20 before rising to about 6% at Layer29. A dashed gray line labeled "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" is also shown, starting near 0% and increasing steadily to approximately 7% at Layer29.
